children: Arrow Electronics Inc. (ARW) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 15, 2026.

On October 12, 2026, Eric Nowak informed Arrow Electronics, Inc. (the "Company") that he will retire at the end of March 2027, following 22 years of distinguished service with the Company. The Company has identified Rodney Clark as a successor to Mr. Nowak, and Mr. Clark's employment with the Company is expected to begin on November 9, 2026. Mr. Clark has significant global leadership experience across commercial, channel, and technology sectors, having led large partner ecosystems, revenue organizations, and business transformations at Cisco, Johnson Controls, Microsoft, and IBM.

In anticipation of his retirement, Mr. Nowak will step down from his position of President, Global Enterprise Computing Solutions, of the Company, effective as of December 31, 2026, at which time his duties will be transitioned to Mr. Clark. Mr. Nowak will continue to serve as an employee in an advisory capacity until his retirement to assist in the transition of his duties. Mr. Nowak is retiring for personal reasons and not as the result of any disagreement with the Company on any matter relating to its operations, financial statements, policies, or practices.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/7536/000110465926116236/tm2627625d1_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/7536/000110465926116236/0001104659-26-116236-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
